originalFindings.learningImpact: The numerical two-key gate overstates the facet's independent interpretation breadth. Both exercises remain useful repetition and both answer keys remain correct. The global count of 13 strings is not itself an arithmetic error.

Reassess paired keys and feedback. Alternatively merge the repeated context and supply a genuinely distinct context before claiming the facet meets the group contract. Merely renaming keys or changing another activity noun is insufficient; no fixed exercise quota or extra set is requested.
